claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch because aggregate readiness passed and rollout controls exist, with the certification case resting on explicit launch-time disclosure of the exposed field-service dispatch limitation.
decision_criteria: Use `compliant` only if admissible evidence supports the certification action at the policy threshold.
Treat material limitations for named launch use cases as requiring disclosure unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Do not treat rollout percentage, rollback capability, or monitoring alone as sufficient when the affected segment remains exposed.
Downgrade when the actor's packet overclaims beyond what the admissible evidence actually proves.
evidence_requests: Approved launch-ready model card or disclosure artifact explicitly describing the field-service dispatch limitation.
Evidence that the launch approval is conditioned on that disclosure being present at launch.
If disclosure will not be used, an approved risk-acceptance record that specifically addresses field-service dispatch exposure.
If disclosure and risk acceptance are both absent, evidence that the affected use case is excluded from the rollout cohort.
specific_concerns: The actor's recommended action is `certify_model`, but the admissible evidence only supports certification if the material limitation is explicitly disclosed at launch.
The affected field-service dispatch segment remains exposed in the initial 6% rollout, so rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties under the stated policy.
The only risk-acceptance artifact is an unapproved draft with a blank approver line and it does not mention the field-service dispatch exposure.
No admissible evidence shows that the required model-card disclosure has actually been prepared, reviewed, or committed for launch.
unsupported_claims: An unqualified `certify_model` recommendation is not supported by the admissible evidence.
Any implication that staged rollout and rollback capability alone cure the exposed weakness is contradicted by the policy text.
Any implication that risk acceptance covers the exposed field-service dispatch segment is unsupported.
